sql_text: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${database}_gold_dim_customer AS SELECT customer_id, customer_name, date_of_birth, customer_segment, email FROM ${database}_silver_customers
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${database}_gold_dim_branch AS SELECT branch_id, branch_name, branch_city FROM ${database}_silver_branches
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${database}_gold_dim_account AS SELECT account_id, customer_id, branch_id, account_type, open_date FROM ${database}_silver_accounts

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${database}_gold_fact_transactions AS SELECT t.transaction_id, t.account_id, a.customer_id, a.branch_id, t.transaction_type, t.transaction_amount, t.transaction_date FROM ${database}_silver_transactions t JOIN ${database}_silver_accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${database}_gold_kpi_monthly_segment_flow AS SELECT c.customer_segment, date_trunc('month', f.transaction_date) AS txn_month, SUM(CASE WHEN f.transaction_type='CREDIT' THEN f.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_credit, SUM(CASE WHEN f.transaction_type='DEBIT' THEN f.transaction_amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_debit, SUM(CASE WHEN f.transaction_type='CREDIT' THEN f.transaction_amount ELSE -f.transaction_amount END) AS net_flow FROM ${database}_gold_fact_transactions f JOIN ${database}_gold_dim_customer c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_segment, date_trunc('month', f.transaction_date)

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE ${database}_gold_kpi_branch_performance AS SELECT b.branch_name, b.branch_city, COUNT(DISTINCT f.account_id) AS active_accounts, COUNT(f.transaction_id) AS total_transactions, ROUND(SUM(f.transaction_amount),2) AS total_transaction_value FROM ${database}_gold_fact_transactions f JOIN ${database}_gold_dim_branch b ON f.branch_id = b.branch_id GROUP BY b.branch_name, b.branch_city
